target_customer: Automotive dealerships, mainly service and sales departments
problem: Dealerships miss inbound calls and lose service appointments; Toma voice agents answer calls and book work.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice agents with writeback into dealership management systems are demanding but built on commodity speech and LLM components.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with dealer systems and policy learning (Toma IQ, March 2026) add stickiness, but Numa and Impel compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Numa claims 1,200+ dealerships versus Toma's 100+.

market_need_then: Dealership service departments lose revenue on missed calls; the manifesto and press describe thousands of AI calls daily and 100+ dealers by 2025.

branding.domain_note: Launched on toma.so and moved to toma.com (domain blog, date not given).

identity.visual_style: Clean modern SaaS with a manifesto page

rebrands.why: Domain upgrade for brand consistency per a domain industry blog; the name itself did not change.

branding.community_and_virality: Dealership influencer Yossi Levi invested; trademark TOMA registered March 2026 per USPTO listing.

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable name and a dedicated domain, but no independent brand press.

outcome_analysis: Toma reached seven figure ARR in under a year, approached eight figures with over 100 dealerships, and raised a $17M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz in June 2025. Strong early traction and a clear vertical help, though Numa has a much larger dealer base, so scale versus competition decides the next outcome.
notes: A $500K pre-seed in February 2024 (YC, Vijay Krishnan) appears only on aggregators and is not recorded as a round. One listing names Breakpoint Capital as lead; company and law firm sources say a16z. Total raised figures vary ($17.5M to $17.6M). Headcount estimates conflict (36 vs 61). Competitor sources found were 2025 and 2026 vendor comparisons, not dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Competition list empty: no sources dated near the batch were found.
